⚠️ **This type is _unstable_ and may change significantly in a way that the data won't be backwards compatible.**
Stable identity for an audio source across streams, assets, summaries, and annotations.

This is intentionally independent from entity path: an entity path names where
data was logged, while an audio source id names the logical recording, device,
track, or pipeline output that downstream derived data refers to.
